title: Democracy and memory in the Southern Cone
goal: I can say how Argentina, Chile and Uruguay faced their past, using a pesar de.

items: I can say what stood in the way of justice in Argentina, Chile and Uruguay, using a pesar de.
I can say what happened to Pinochet in 1998.
I can say what Uruguayan voters decided in 1989.
I can use a pesar de and a pesar de que to say what happened despite an obstacle.
I can use the new words for immunity, senator and debate.
